mentions.name: Pockli
mentions.description: Pockli is a workflow tool for managing the stream of documents people hand you, so they can be pulled back up months or years later when needed.
mentions.audience: Managing the flood of documents others hand you, which must still be findable and retrievable months or years later.
mentions.source_excerpt: https://pockli.com - I've always needed a better workflow for managing the stream of documents people hand me — then expect me to pull out of a hat months or years later, like a magician.
